description: Renovate All-Purpose Config for PHP/Node/Docker projects. For detailed help and options, see: https://docs.renovatebot.com/

pecl-gmagick.description: Latest gmagick release on PECL (plain text endpoint, e.g. `2.0.6RC1`).

customManagers.description: Track pg_cron, which is built from a git clone pinned by the PG_CRON_VERSION ARG - no built-in manager sees it (it is not a FROM image).

Trivy pin in the standalone GitLab security-scan pipeline. The TRIVY_VERSION variable feeds both the aquasec/trivy job image (referenced as aquasec/trivy:${TRIVY_VERSION}, invisible to the gitlabci docker manager) and the release-binary install in the dind-based image-scan jobs, so it needs its own tracker.

Dockle pin in the GitHub security-scan workflow. Dockle is installed from the GitHub release tarball (DOCKLE_VERSION env) instead of the dockle-action container, whose Docker Hub pull repeatedly hit i/o timeouts - no built-in manager sees the version.

PECL release watcher for gmagick, which is built from a commit-pinned fork because no PECL release compiles against PHP >= 8.5. The baseline ARG is watch-only: a PR bumping it signals that PECL lists a newer release worth reviewing for a switch back to `pecl install`.

packageRules.description: Disable Renovate for first-party built images (zappzarapp-*). These are built from docker/<service>/Dockerfile and referenced by kubernetes/values.yaml; the upstream version is pinned only in the Dockerfile ARG (single source of truth) and tracked by the dockerfile manager. They are not published to any registry, so Renovate cannot and must not look them up.
Group Docker base-image updates by image name so the same upstream image referenced from more than one Dockerfile (e.g. a shared base or build stage) is bumped in a single PR.
PHP Composer Updates - Exclude major application frameworks for individual review.
Immediate merge of security patches (High Priority)
Never automerge major updates - always require manual review (last rule wins).
Hold TypeScript 7 majors: typescript-eslint and typedoc do not support v7.0 yet. Remove this rule once TypeScript 7.1 lands with ecosystem support.

The pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides are per-major security FLOORS (see the comment there: floors must not cross a semver major - a v3 consumer must never be handed v5). Never propose major bumps for them; within-major floor bumps stay enabled.

The gmagick PECL watcher PR is a review signal (check PHP >= 8.5 support before switching back from the commit-pinned fork build) - never automerge, regardless of update type. RC releases count too (a new RC is the most likely shape of a PHP-8.5-capable release from the dormant upstream), so unstable versions must not be filtered. The plain-text datasource carries no releaseTimestamp, so the global minimumReleaseAge would hold the update as pending forever - disable it here.
